# OpenGMK vendored source

This directory is a source snapshot of https://github.com/OpenGMK/OpenGMK,
based on upstream commit `9e4282e6d19f4dd00961811840ddc3e11da6dd5a`,
with Android integration and compatibility changes tracked by the enclosing
Reloaded Engine repository.

It is included directly rather than as a Git submodule so the corresponding
modified source is present in clones and release archives. Original license
and copyright notices remain in place; see LICENCE.md and the root
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for attribution, including adaptations informed by
Klisee's implementation.
